entries.examples/board/client/main.ts: The browser script of the board example: make assets bundles it with hyper-build-assets --app examples/board.
entries.examples/board/node/main.ts: The board Node server: make node-server bundles it with esbuild into examples/board/build/node/server.mjs.
entries.tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts: The Playwright configuration of make e2e: scripts/run-e2e.mts runs playwright test --config with it.
entries.tests/scripts/fixtures/chunks/client/mai: The fixture app of the chunk tests of hyper-build-assets, which tests/scripts bundle by its directory.

binaries.container: Apple container, whose bind mounts are virtiofs: make virtiofs-check (tests/virtiofs) runs it on Darwin.

packages/build.reason: The npm package @polyspec/hyper-build, a workspace of the root package.json.

ignoreDependencies.tailwindcss: bin/hyper-build-assets.mjs compiles the stylesheet of an app with @tailwindcss/node from the CSS text '@import "tailwindcss/theme.css"' and the other layers of tailwindcss, which Tailwind CSS resolves from this package; knip reads no import in that text.
